evidence_excerpt: Jordan Lee says reps prepare from scattered notes and sometimes use outdated product information.
Jordan asks whether SignalNest connects directly to Salesforce. The sales rep says this needs confirmation.
Jordan would like to see how supplied call notes can become a useful preparation brief.
October 27 is suggested for a follow-up, but is not confirmed.
SignalNest creates preparation drafts from supplied notes and approved reference documents.
A manually supplied Salesforce export can be used.
Native Salesforce integration is not generally available.
